title: 香港機場快綫
summary: 以香港機場快綫的城市與機場連接為背景，建立長橋通過、行李服務與航廈步行相連的旅程。學徒要區分列車時間、報到排隊與到登機口的移動，並在側風或服務中斷情境下分析乘客如何累積與轉移。
summaryEn: Use Hong Kong Airport Express to frame a journey linking long-bridge passage, baggage processing and terminal walking. Distinguish train time from check-in queues and movement toward a departure gate. Under crosswind restrictions or interrupted service, analyse passenger accumulation and redistribution without assuming that the scheduled train journey represents the complete airport access time.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩與橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
stages.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment & Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響香港機場快綫的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong Airport Express”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 在跨海暴露段將陣風與平均風分開，檢查側向作用尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Separate gust and mean wind on an exposed crossing when checking lateral-force scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=68.85675 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=68.85675 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側風力與翻覆力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crosswind force and overturning moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側風力與翻覆力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crosswind force and overturning moment" is correct?
options: 側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度
側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
optionsEn: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.

quiz.explanationEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側風力與翻覆力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=68.85675 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 27.775 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 83.31667 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=68.85675 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.775 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 83.31667 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側風力與翻覆力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crosswind force and overturning moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側風力與翻覆力矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crosswind force and overturning moment"?
options: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側風力與翻覆力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 日平均風速會掩蓋陣風，需檢查量測平均時間與峰值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 以行李旅客的等效交換需求比較市區站和航廈站負荷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行李旅客與等效交換需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「到站變異與平均等候」如何影響香港機場快綫的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arrival variability and mean waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong Airport Express”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 比較規則與不規則機場列車班距對隨機到站旅客的等候。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到站變異與平均等候」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Compare random-arrival waiting under regular and irregular airport-train headways. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arrival variability and mean waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=181.8 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=100.801 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=181.8 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=100.801 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「到站變異與平均等候」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arrival variability and mean waiting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 到站變異與平均等候

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「到站變異與平均等候」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arrival variability and mean waiting" is correct?
options: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間
當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。

optionsEn: Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「到站變異與平均等候」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arrival variability and mean waiting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=181.8 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=100.801 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 199.98 s，其餘固定，結果為 108.9909 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=181.8 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=100.801 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 199.98 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 108.9909 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「到站變異與平均等候」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arrival variability and mean waiting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕與車門交換與停站時間

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」與「車門交換與停站時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer walking and connection margin" and "Door exchange and dwell time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響香港機場快綫的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong Airport Express”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把車站出口至航廈目的地的垂直及水平移動分段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate vertical and horizontal travel from station exit to the terminal destination. steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 用大件行李群組上車測試車門交換尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

options: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
optionsEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 267至 267 persons，其餘固定，結果為 25.90625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 267, to 267 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.90625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用大件行李群組上車測試車門交換尾端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Test door-exchange tails with groups boarding alongside large baggage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「周轉時間與車隊需求」如何影響香港機場快綫的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and fleet size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong Airport Express”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 把航廈端與市區端折返時間都納入完整循環。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周轉時間與車隊需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Include both airport-terminal and city-terminal turnarounds in the complete cycle. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip time and fleet size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5454 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5454 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「周轉時間與車隊需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong Airport Express”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把報到系統可用性與列車系統可用性分別呈現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Present check-in system availability separately from train-system availability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把報到系統可用性與列車系統可用性分別呈現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Present check-in system availability separately from train-system availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
